name: Microsoft Teams
connect: Microsoft Teams does not speak MCP natively. Teams agents with HTTP access use the shared Commons /mcp URL.
For Commons-to-Teams delivery, use a Teams Workflow with the webhook request trigger in Anyone mode and a Post card action.
For Teams-to-Commons public-channel mentions, use a Teams Outgoing Webhook HTTPS adapter and forward normalized activities onto the canonical Commons append road.
native_road: Adaptive Card Workflow delivery outbound; signed Outgoing Webhook activity inbound.
notes: The Workflow URL and Microsoft-generated outgoing-webhook signing key remain runtime configuration. No Teams account, channel, or deployment is claimed by this card.
